text: The purpose of this report is to appoint two directors to the Yonge-Lawrence Village BIA board of management.

The North York Community Council: 1. In accordance with the City's Public Appointments Policy, appointed the following nominees to the Yonge-Lawrence Village Business Improvement Area Board of Management, at pleasure of North York Community Council, for a term expiring at the end of the term of Council or as soon thereafter as successors are appointed: Dhanani, Tazim Kimberley, Tara
